Standard: The air vehicle's trim system characteristics do not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the trim system characteristics as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Trim System paragraph, Trim System Irreversibility paragraph, Rate of Trim Operation paragraph, Stalling of Trim Systems paragraph, Trim for Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, and Automatic Trim System paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the trim system characteristics as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Trim System paragraph, Trim System Irreversibility paragraph, Rate of Trim Operation paragraph, Stalling of Trim Systems paragraph, Trim for Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, and Automatic Trim System paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the trim system characteristics as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Trim System paragraph, Trim System Irreversibility paragraph, Rate of Trim Operation paragraph, Stalling of Trim Systems paragraph, Trim for Asymmetric Thrust paragraph, and Automatic Trim System paragraph, for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
